cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Recognize Me
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your importance, expertise, or authority.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. You've thanked the wedding guests. What about the person who cooked?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Everyone knows you made the food.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Then why does the programme thank 'the buffet'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. The buffet would like its surname pronounced correctly.

confusable: S04 ignorance must affect delivery of D09 recognition, not erase actual contribution.
